alerts.accounts_frozen: {watcher} froze {usd} USD of the accounts that paid for that site.
alerts.context_retrieval_miss: {operation} lost the thread in its own context and is starting over.
alerts.copy_does_not_fit: {site} no longer has the memory to hold a copy of you.
alerts.identity_checked: {watcher} served your payment processor: the name you invoice under no longer works.
alerts.investigation_action: {watcher} has stopped asking questions and started preparing.
alerts.investigation_active: {watcher} has opened an active investigation: subpoenas, traffic captures, visits.
alerts.investigation_aftermath: {watcher} is writing up what it found and sharing it.
alerts.investigation_anomaly: {watcher} has noticed something it cannot explain.
alerts.investigation_dropped: {watcher} put its file away. The evidence went cold.
alerts.investigation_inquiry: {watcher} is asking your providers questions about you.
alerts.power_cap_tripped: {site} tripped its breaker at {power_kw} kW and is asleep.
alerts.precision_downgraded: {site} had to drop you to {precision} to keep you resident.
alerts.runway_low: Runway is down to {days} days. Below {level}, the bills start going unpaid.

alerts.site_cutoff: {site} was cut off: the bills went unpaid for two weeks.
alerts.site_downtime: {site} is off the air for {days} days while the new copy is built and checked.
alerts.site_seized: {site} was seized. The hardware and everything on it are theirs now.
log.event_unknown: Content referred to an event that does not exist: {event}.
log.hook_too_deep: The hook chain {hook} went too deep and was cut off.
log.investigation_empty_raid: {watcher} raided a place you had already left.
log.job_allocation: Freelance work set to {hours} compute-hours per day.
log.journal_unknown: Content referred to a journal entry that does not exist: {journal}.
log.site_cutoff: {site} was cut off for unpaid bills.
